Folio 1.0-beta5 reorganizes the panel around clear status summaries, shorter lists and direct resource pages. 五项底栏保持原顺序，全面优化页面信息和操作。

- 首页精简为主机、网站、应用三个区域；任务、便签和记录移入二级页面。
- 手机支持自然下滑，顶栏只保留“查看任务”；桌面另保留账户入口。
- 语言切换移至“更多 → 语言与外观”；支持中英双语、三套字体与五套配色，切换保留页面和输入。字体随面板提供，无需外部字体服务。
- 网站、软件、应用与文件采用更紧凑的分页列表，复杂详情进入独立页面；浏览器返回、刷新和直接链接保留导航上下文。
- 软件默认显示已安装服务；资源配置、日志与备份按所属资源归组，减少重复信息。应用日志可直接查看，错误留在对应操作上下文。
- 保留草稿保护、危险操作确认、权限、版本校验与防重复提交。未知、无权限和读取失败分别呈现；网站启用状态不等同公网健康。
- `sites_list` 兼容新增可选状态筛选及 `status_counts`，基于完整授权且已筛选的集合统计，再进行分页。

The overview now focuses on host, website and application status. Mobile pages scroll naturally with a single task button in the header. Language, font and theme choices live under More → Language & appearance. Resource pages, pagination, hash links and browser navigation make everyday operations easier while preserving drafts and existing safeguards.

Linux amd64 and arm64 archives are provided. Runtime acceptance in this release covers amd64; the managed-service target remains Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 with systemd. ARM64 is cross-built, not newly runtime-certified. The one-command installer targets amd64 and retains the existing bilingual installation flow, configuration, data and Agent-policy preservation.

Chinese installation / 中文安装：

```sh
curl -fsSL https://github.com/Aoody743/Folio/releases/download/1.0-beta5/install-1.0-beta5.sh | sudo bash -s -- --lang zh-CN
```

Use `--lang en` for English and add `--yes` for unattended installation. The default listener remains localhost.

Verification covers 93 frontend tests, Go race tests, installer checks, the packaged amd64 binary, real file/notes/schedule operations and 30 language/font/theme combinations across five viewport sizes. Large website/application collections in the layout tests are explicit display fixtures; authorization and counts have separate Go integration coverage. No new public DNS/CA or ARM runtime claim is made.

See `ACCEPTANCE.json`, `verification-logs.tar.gz` and `SHA256SUMS.txt` for release evidence, checksums and validation limits. This is a prerelease.
